title: باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ تُسَافِرُ مَسِيرَةَ ثَلاَثِ لَيَالٍ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to us. Ibn Abi Fudayk informed us. al-Dahhak informed us, from Nafi, from Abd Allah ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to travel for a journey of three nights except with a mahram accompanying her.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte uns. Ibn Abi Fudayk berichtete uns. al-Dahhak berichtete uns, from Nafi, from Abd Allah ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: It is not erlaubt for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to reisen for a Reise of drei nights except with a Mahram accompanying her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1339 a, book 15, باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
title: باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ مُسْلِمَةٍ تُسَافِرُ مَسِيرَةَ لَيْلَةٍ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا رَجُلٌ ذُو حُرْمَةٍ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Layth narrated to us, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from his father, that Abu Hurayra said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: It is not lawful for a Muslim woman to travel for the distance of one night except with a man who is permanently unlawful for her to marry.
translation_de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Layth überlieferte uns, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from his father, that Abu Hurayra said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: It is not erlaubt for a Muslim woman to reisen for the distance of one night except with a man who is permanently unerlaubt for her to marry. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1339 b, book 15, باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
title: باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ، بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ تُسَافِرُ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمٍ إِلاَّ مَعَ ذِي مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b. Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id narrated to us, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to travel for the distance of one day except with a mahram.
translation_de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Yahya ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b. Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id überlieferte uns, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: It is not erlaubt for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to reisen for the distance of one day except with a Mahram. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1339 c, book 15, باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
title: باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ تُسَافِرُ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ إِلاَّ مَعَ ذِي مَحْرَمٍ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to travel for the distance of a day and a night except with a mahram accompanying her.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: It is not erlaubt for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to reisen for the distance of a day and a night except with a Mahram accompanying her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1339 d, book 15, باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
title: باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلُ بْنُ، أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ أَنْ تُسَافِرَ ثَلاَثًا إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated to us. Bishr, meaning Ibn al-Mufaddal, narrated to us. Suhayl ibn Abi Salih narrated to us, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: It is not lawful for a woman to travel for three days except with a mahram accompanying her.
translation_de: Abu Kamil al-Jahdari überlieferte uns. Bishr, meaning Ibn al-Mufaddal, überlieferte uns. Suhayl ibn Abi Salih überlieferte uns, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: It is not erlaubt for a woman to reisen for drei Tage except with a Mahram accompanying her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1340 a, book 15, باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
title: باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا - عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ تُسَافِرَ سَفَرًا يَكُونُ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَصَاعِدًا إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا أَبُوهَا أَوِ ابْنُهَا أَوْ زَوْجُهَا أَوْ أَخُوهَا أَوْ ذُو مَحْرَمٍ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us, from Abu Muawiyah. Abu Kurayb said: Abu Muawiyah narrated to us, from al-Amash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to travel a journey of three days or more except with her father, son, husband, brother, or a mahram who is permanently unlawful for her to marry.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns, from Abu Muawiyah. Abu Kurayb said: Abu Muawiyah überlieferte uns, from al-Amash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: It is not erlaubt for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to reisen a Reise of drei Tage or more except with her father, son, husband, brother, or a Mahram who is permanently unerlaubt for her to marry. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj narrated to us. They said: Waki narrated to us. Al-Amash narrated to us, with this chain and the same meaning.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj überlieferte uns. They said: Waki überlieferte uns. Al-Amash überlieferte uns, with this chain and the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْبَدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَخْلُوَنَّ رَجُلٌ بِامْرَأَةٍ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ وَلاَ تُسَافِرِ الْمَرْأَةُ إِلاَّ مَعَ ذِي مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ امْرَأَتِي خَرَجَتْ حَاجَّةً وَإِنِّي اكْتُتِبْتُ فِي غَزْوَةِ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْطَلِقْ فَحُجَّ مَعَ امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us, both from Sufyan. Abu Bakr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us. Amr ibn Dinar narrated to us, from Abu Ma'bad. He said: I heard Ibn Abbas say: I heard the Prophet (peace be upon him) deliver a sermon saying: No man should be alone with a woman unless she has a mahram with her, and a woman should not travel except with a mahram. A man stood and said: Messenger of Allah, my wife has gone out for Hajj, while I have been enlisted for such-and-such expedition. He said: Go and perform Hajj with your wife.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns, both from Sufyan. Abu Bakr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns. Amr ibn Dinar überlieferte uns, from Abu Ma'bad. Er sagte: I heard Ibn Abbas say: I heard der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) deliver a sermon saying: No man should be alone with a woman unless she has a Mahram with her, and a woman should not reisen except with a Mahram. A man stood and said: Messenger of Allah, my wife has gone out for Hadsch, while I have been enlisted for such-and-such expedition. Er sagte: Go and perform Hadsch with your wife. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani narrated it to us. Hammad narrated to us, from Amr, with this chain, with a similar meaning.
translation_de: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani narrated it to us. Hammad überlieferte uns, from Amr, with this chain, with a similar meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سُلَيْمَانَ - الْمَخْزُومِيُّ عَنِ ابْنِ، جُرَيْجٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏"‏ لاَ يَخْلُوَنَّ رَجُلٌ بِامْرَأَةٍ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Hisham, meaning Ibn Sulayman al-Makhzumi, narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, with this chain and a similar meaning, but he did not mention: No man should be alone with a woman unless she has a mahram with her.
translation_de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Hisham, meaning Ibn Sulayman al-Makhzumi, überlieferte uns, from Ibn Jurayj, with this chain and a similar meaning, but he did not mention: No man should be alone with a woman unless she has a Mahram with her. title: باب مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا رَكِبَ إِلَى سَفَرٍ الْحَجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَلِيًّا الأَزْدِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَلَّمَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اسْتَوَى عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ خَارِجًا إِلَى سَفَرٍ كَبَّرَ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ ‏"‏ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Harun ibn Abd Allah narrated to me. Hajjaj ibn Muhammad narrated to us. He said: Ibn Jurayj said: Abu al-Zubayr informed me that Ali al-Azdi informed him that Ibn Umar taught them that when the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) mounted his camel when setting out on a journey, he proclaimed Allah's greatness three times and then said: Glory be to the One who subjected this to us, while we could not have controlled it, and surely to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness, piety, and deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold up its distance for us. O Allah, You are the companion on the journey and the guardian over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, the distressing sight, and a bad return concerning wealth and family. When he returned, he said these words and added: Returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.
translation_de: Harun ibn Abd Allah überlieferte mir. Hadschaj ibn Muhammad überlieferte uns. Er sagte: Ibn Jurayj said: Abu al-Zubayr berichtete mir that Ali al-Azdi informed him that Ibn Umar taught them that when der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) mounted his camel when setting out on a Reise, he proclaimed Allah's greatness drei times and then said: Glory be to the One who subjected this to us, while we could not have controlled it, and surely to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this Reise of ours for righteousness, piety, and deeds that please You. O Allah, make this Reise easy for us and fold up its distance for us. O Allah, You are the companion on the Reise and the guardian over the Familie. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of reisen, the distressing sight, and a bad return concerning wealth and Familie. When he returned, he said these words and added: Returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا رَكِبَ إِلَى سَفَرٍ الْحَجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ سَرْجِسَ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَافَرَ يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَالْحَوْرِ بَعْدَ الْكَوْرِ وَدَعْوَةِ الْمَظْلُومِ وَسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Ismail ibn Ulayyah narrated to us, from Asim al-Ahwal, from Abd Allah ibn Sarjis. He said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) travelled, he sought refuge from the hardship of travel, the distressing return, turning back after progress, the supplication of the oppressed, and an evil sight concerning family and wealth.
translation_de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Ismail ibn Ulayyah überlieferte uns, from Asim al-Ahwal, from Abd Allah ibn Sarjis. Er sagte: When der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) reisenled, he sought refuge from the hardship of reisen, the distressing return, turning back after progress, the supplication of the oppressed, and an evil sight concerning Familie and wealth. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1343 b, book 15, باب مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا رَكِبَ إِلَى سَفَرٍ الْحَجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
title: باب مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا رَكِبَ إِلَى سَفَرٍ الْحَجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَازِمٍ قَالَ يَبْدَأُ بِالأَهْلِ إِذَا رَجَعَ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَتِهِمَا جَمِيعًا ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us, both from Abu Muawiyah. H; and Hamid ibn Umar narrated to me. Abd al-Wahid narrated to us. Both narrated from Asim, with this chain and the same meaning, except that in Abd al-Wahid's narration it says: concerning wealth and family. In Muhammad ibn Khazim's narration it says: He begins with the family when he returns. In both of their narrations it says: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns, both from Abu Muawiyah. H; and Hamid ibn Umar überlieferte mir. Abd al-Wahid überlieferte uns. Both narrated from Asim, with this chain and the same meaning, except that in Abd al-Wahid's narration it says: concerning wealth and Familie. In Muhammad ibn Khazim's narration it says: He begins with the Familie when he returns. In both of their narrations it says: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of reisen. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1344 a, book 15, باب مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ الْحَجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
title: باب مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ الْحَجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ح . وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنَ الْجُيُوشِ أَوِ السَّرَايَا أَوِ الْحَجِّ أَوِ الْعُمْرَةِ إِذَا أَوْفَى عَلَى ثَنِيَّةٍ أَوْ فَدْفَدٍ كَبَّرَ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ سَاجِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. H; and Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, and this is his wording. Yahya, al-Qattan, narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Abd Allah ibn Umar. He said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) returned from armies, expeditions, Hajj, or Umrah, and climbed a mountain pass or a high plain, he proclaimed Allah's greatness three times and then said: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. The kingdom and praise belong to Him, and He is powerful over everything. We return, repent, worship, prostrate, and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, helped His servant, and defeated the confederates alone.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. H; and Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, and this is his wording. Yahya, al-Qattan, überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Abd Allah ibn Umar. Er sagte: When der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) returned from armies, expeditions, Hadsch, or Umra, and climbed a mountain pass or a high plain, he proclaimed Allah's greatness drei times and then said: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. The kingdom and praise belong to Him, and He is powerful over everything. We return, repent, worship, prostrate, and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, helped His servant, and defeated the confederates alone. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ الْحَجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ إِلاَّ حَدِيثَ أَيُّوبَ فَإِنَّ فِيهِ التَّكْبِيرَ مَرَّتَيْنِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Ismail, meaning Ibn Ulayyah, narrated to us, from Ayyub. H; Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Ma'n narrated to us, from Malik. H; Ibn Rafi narrated to us. Ibn Abi Fudayk informed us. Al-Dahhak informed us. All of them narrated from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning, except that Ayyub's hadith says that the proclamation of Allah's greatness was made twice.
translation_de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Ismail, meaning Ibn Ulayyah, überlieferte uns, from Ayyub. H; Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Ma'n überlieferte uns, from Malik. H; Ibn Rafi überlieferte uns. Ibn Abi Fudayk berichtete uns. Al-Dahhak berichtete uns. All of them narrated from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning, except that Ayyub's hadith says that the proclamation of Allah's greatness was made twice. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ الْحَجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَا وَأَبُو طَلْحَةَ ‏.‏ وَصَفِيَّةُ رَدِيفَتُهُ عَلَى نَاقَتِهِ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِظَهْرِ الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Ismail ibn Ulayyah narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Abi Ishaq. Anas ibn Malik said: Abu Talhah, Safiyyah riding behind him on his camel, and I came back with the Prophet (peace be upon him). When we were behind Madinah, he said: Returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord. He continued saying that until we reached Madinah.
translation_de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Ismail ibn Ulayyah überlieferte uns, from Yahya ibn Abi Ishaq. Anas ibn Malik said: Abu Talhah, Safiyyah riding behind him on his camel, and I came back with der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). When we were behind Medina, he said: Returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord. He continued saying that until we reached Medina. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

translation_en: Humayd ibn Masadah narrated to us. Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal narrated to us. Yahya ibn Abi Ishaq narrated to us, from Anas ibn Malik, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning.
translation_de: Humayd ibn Masadah überlieferte uns. Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal überlieferte uns. Yahya ibn Abi Ishaq überlieferte uns, from Anas ibn Malik, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1346 a, book 15, باب التَّعْرِيسِ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ بِهَا إِذَا صَدَرَ مِنَ الْحَجِّ أَوِ الْعُمْرَةِ ‏‏
title: باب التَّعْرِيسِ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ بِهَا إِذَا صَدَرَ مِنَ الْحَجِّ أَوِ الْعُمْرَةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ مُوسَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُقْبَةَ - عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ فِي مُعَرَّسِهِ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّكَ بِبَطْحَاءَ مُبَارَكَةٍ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Abbad narrated to us. Hatim, meaning Ibn Ismail, narrated to us, from Musa, meaning Ibn Uqbah, from Salim, from his father, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was brought, at his resting place in Dhu al-Hulayfah, the message: You are in a blessed valley.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Abbad überlieferte uns. Hatim, meaning Ibn Ismail, überlieferte uns, from Musa, meaning Ibn Uqbah, from Salim, from his father, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) was brought, at his resting place in Dhu al-Hulayfah, the message: You are in a blessed valley. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1346 b, book 15, باب التَّعْرِيسِ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ بِهَا إِذَا صَدَرَ مِنَ الْحَجِّ أَوِ الْعُمْرَةِ ‏‏
title: باب التَّعْرِيسِ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ بِهَا إِذَا صَدَرَ مِنَ الْحَجِّ أَوِ الْعُمْرَةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكَّارِ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ، وَسُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِسُرَيْجٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ وَهُوَ فِي مُعَرَّسِهِ مِنْ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ فِي بَطْنِ الْوَادِي فَقِيلَ إِنَّكَ بِبَطْحَاءَ مُبَارَكَةٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُوسَى وَقَدْ أَنَاخَ بِنَا سَالِمٌ بِالْمُنَاخِ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الَّذِي كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يُنِيخُ بِهِ يَتَحَرَّى مُعَرَّسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ أَسْفَلُ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الَّذِي بِبَطْنِ الْوَادِي بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْقِبْلَةِ وَسَطًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Bakr ibn al-Rayyan and Surayj ibn Yunus narrated to us, and Surayj's wording is used. They said: Ismail ibn Ja'far narrated to us. Musa ibn Uqbah informed me, from Salim ibn Abd Allah ibn Umar, from his father, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) was brought a message while he was resting at Dhu al-Hulayfah, in the valley below: You are in a blessed plain. Musa said: Salim made us stop at the place beside the mosque where Abd Allah used to stop, seeking the resting place of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). It is lower than the mosque in the valley, midway between it and the qiblah.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Bakr ibn al-Rayyan and Surayj ibn Yunus überlieferte uns, and Surayj's wording is used. They said: Ismail ibn Ja'far überlieferte uns. Musa ibn Uqbah berichtete mir, from Salim ibn Abd Allah ibn Umar, from his father, that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) was brought a message while he was resting at Dhu al-Hulayfah, in the valley below: You are in a blessed plain. Musa said: Salim made us stop at the place beside the mosque where Abd Allah used to stop, seeking the resting place of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). It is lower than the mosque in the valley, midway between it and the qiblah. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1347, book 15, باب لاَ يَحُجُّ الْبَيْتَ مُشْرِكٌ وَلاَ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ وَبَيَانُ يَوْمِ الْحَجِّ الأَكْبَبَرِ
title: باب لاَ يَحُجُّ الْبَيْتَ مُشْرِكٌ وَلاَ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ وَبَيَانُ يَوْمِ الْحَجِّ الأَكْبَبَرِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح . وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ بَعَثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ فِي الْحَجَّةِ الَّتِي أَمَّرَهُ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْلَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فِي رَهْطٍ يُؤَذِّنُونَ فِي النَّاسِ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ لاَ يَحُجُّ بَعْدَ الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ وَلاَ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَكَانَ حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ يَقُولُ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ يَوْمُ الْحَجِّ الأَكْبَرِ ‏.‏ مِنْ أَجْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Amr informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurayra. H; and Harmalah ibn Yahya al-Tujibi narrated to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed us that Ibn Shihab informed him, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, from Abu Hurayra. He said: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq sent me in the Hajj in which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) appointed him, before the Farewell Hajj, with a group who proclaimed to the people on the Day of Sacrifice: After this year no polytheist will perform Hajj and no naked person will circumambulate the House. Ibn Shihab said: Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman used to say: The Day of Sacrifice is the Day of the Greater Hajj, because of the hadith of Abu Hurayra.
translation_de: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Amr berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurayra. H; and Harmalah ibn Yahya al-Tujibi überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete uns that Ibn Shihab informed him, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq sent me in the Hadsch in which der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) appointed him, before the Farewell Hadsch, with a group who proclaimed to the people on the Opfertag: After this year no Götzendiener will perform Hadsch and no naked person will circumambulate the Haus. Ibn Shihab said: Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman used to say: The Opfertag is the Day of the Greater Hadsch, because of the hadith of Abu Hurayra. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1348, book 15, باب فِي فَضْلِ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ وَيَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ ‏‏
title: باب فِي فَضْلِ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ وَيَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يُونُسَ بْنَ يُوسُفَ، يَقُولُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ يَوْمٍ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ أَنْ يُعْتِقَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ عَبْدًا مِنَ النَّارِ مِنْ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ وَإِنَّهُ لَيَدْنُو ثُمَّ يُبَاهِي بِهِمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ فَيَقُولُ مَا أَرَادَ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
translation_en: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli and Ahmad ibn Isa narrated to us. They said: Ibn Wahb narrated to us. Makhramah ibn Bukayr informed me, from his father. He said: I heard Yunus ibn Yusuf say, from Ibn al-Musayyib, who said: Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: There is no day on which Allah frees more servants from the Fire than the Day of Arafah. He draws near and boasts of them to the angels, saying: What do these people want?
translation_de: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli and Ahmad ibn Isa überlieferte uns. They said: Ibn Wahb überlieferte uns. Makhramah ibn Bukayr berichtete mir, from his father. Er sagte: I heard Yunus ibn Yusuf say, from Ibn al-Musayyib, who said: Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: There is no day on which Allah frees more servants from the Fire than the Day of Arafah. He draws near and boasts of them to the angels, saying: What do these people want? Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1349 a, book 15, باب فِي فَضْلِ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ وَيَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ ‏‏
title: باب فِي فَضْلِ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ وَيَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْعُمْرَةُ إِلَى الْعُمْرَةِ كَفَّارَةٌ لِمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَالْحَجُّ الْمَبْرُورُ لَيْسَ لَهُ جَزَاءٌ إِلاَّ الْجَنَّةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Sumayy, the freedman of Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Salih al-Samman, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: One Umrah to the next is an expiation for what lies between them, and an accepted Hajj has no reward except Paradise.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Sumayy, the freedman of Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Salih al-Samman, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: One Umra to the next is an expiation for what lies between them, and an accepted Hadsch has no Belohnung except Paradies. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1349 b, book 15, باب فِي فَضْلِ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ وَيَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ ‏‏
title: باب فِي فَضْلِ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ وَيَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
translation_en: Sa'id ibn Mansur, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Amr al-Naqid, and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us. They said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us. H; Muhammad ibn Abd al-Malik al-Umawi narrated to me. Abd al-Aziz ibn al-Mukhtar narrated to us, from Suhayl. H; Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Ubayd Allah narrated to us. H; Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Waki narrated to us. H; Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me. Abd al-Rahman narrated to us. All of them narrated from Sufyan, from Sumayy, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning as Malik's hadith.
translation_de: Sa'id ibn Mansur, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Amr al-Naqid, and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns. They said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns. H; Muhammad ibn Abd al-Malik al-Umawi überlieferte mir. Abd al-Aziz ibn al-Mukhtar überlieferte uns, from Suhayl. H; Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah überlieferte uns. H; Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Waki überlieferte uns. H; Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte mir. Abd al-Rahman überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Sufyan, from Sumayy, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayra, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning as Malik's hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب فِي فَضْلِ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ وَيَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ أَتَى هَذَا الْبَيْتَ فَلَمْ يَرْفُثْ وَلَمْ يَفْسُقْ رَجَعَ كَمَا وَلَدَتْهُ أُمُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us. Yahya said: He informed us, and Zuhayr said: Jarir narrated to us, from Mansur, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever comes to this House and does not engage in sexual speech or sin returns as his mother gave birth to him.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns. Yahya said: He berichtete uns, and Zuhayr said: Jarir überlieferte uns, from Mansur, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever comes to this Haus and does not engage in sexual speech or sin returns as his mother gave birth to him. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب فِي فَضْلِ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ وَيَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ، وَأَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ، بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، وَسُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ‏"‏ مَنْ حَجَّ فَلَمْ يَرْفُثْ وَلَمْ يَفْسُقْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Sa'id ibn Mansur narrated it to us, from Abu Awanah and Abu al-Ahwas. H; Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Waki narrated to us, from Misar and Sufyan. H; Ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us. All of them narrated from Mansur, with this chain. In all their narrations it says: Whoever performs Hajj and does not engage in sexual speech or sin.
translation_de: Sa'id ibn Mansur narrated it to us, from Abu Awanah and Abu al-Ahwas. H; Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Waki überlieferte uns, from Misar and Sufyan. H; Ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Ja'far überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Mansur, with this chain. In all their narrations it says: Whoever performs Hadsch and does not engage in sexual speech or sin. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1350 c, book 15, باب فِي فَضْلِ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ وَيَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ ‏‏
title: باب فِي فَضْلِ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ وَيَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
translation_en: Sa'id ibn Mansur narrated to us. Hushaym narrated to us, from Sayyar, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning.
translation_de: Sa'id ibn Mansur überlieferte uns. Hushaym überlieferte uns, from Sayyar, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayra, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1351 a, book 15, باب النُّزُولِ بِمَكَّةَ لِلْحَاجِّ وَتَوْرِيثِ دُورِهَا ‏‏
title: باب النُّزُولِ بِمَكَّةَ لِلْحَاجِّ وَتَوْرِيثِ دُورِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ حُسَيْنٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَنْزِلُ فِي دَارِكَ بِمَكَّةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَهَلْ تَرَكَ لَنَا عَقِيلٌ مِنْ رِبَاعٍ أَوْ دُورٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ عَقِيلٌ وَرِثَ أَبَا طَالِبٍ هُوَ وَطَالِبٌ وَلَمْ يَرِثْهُ جَعْفَرٌ وَلاَ عَلِيٌّ شَيْئًا لأَنَّهُمَا كَانَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ وَكَانَ عَقِيلٌ وَطَالِبٌ كَافِرَيْنِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me. They said: Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus ibn Yazid informed us, from Ibn Shihab. Ali ibn Husayn informed him that Amr ibn Uthman ibn Affan informed him, from Usamah ibn Zayd ibn Harithah, who said: I said: Messenger of Allah, will you stay in your house in Makkah? He said: Did Aqil leave any houses or dwellings for us? Aqil and Talib inherited Abu Talib, while Ja'far and Ali inherited nothing from him because they were Muslims and Aqil and Talib were disbelievers.
translation_de: Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. They said: Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus ibn Yazid berichtete uns, from Ibn Shihab. Ali ibn Husayn informed him that Amr ibn Uthman ibn Affan informed him, from Usamah ibn Zayd ibn Harithah, who said: I said: Messenger of Allah, will you stay in your house in Makka? Er sagte: Did Aqil leave any houses or dwellings for us? Aqil and Talib inherited Abu Talib, while Ja'far and Ali inherited nothing from him because they were Muslims and Aqil and Talib were disbelievers. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1351 b, book 15, باب النُّزُولِ بِمَكَّةَ لِلْحَاجِّ وَتَوْرِيثِ دُورِهَا ‏‏
title: باب النُّزُولِ بِمَكَّةَ لِلْحَاجِّ وَتَوْرِيثِ دُورِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّزَّاقِ - قَالَ ابْنُ مِهْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، - عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيْنَ تَنْزِلُ غَدًا وَذَلِكَ فِي حَجَّتِهِ حِينَ دَنَوْنَا مِنْ مَكَّةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَهَلْ تَرَكَ لَنَا عَقِيلٌ مَنْزِلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Mihran al-Razi, Ibn Abi Umar, and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us, all from Abd al-Razzaq. Ibn Mihran said: Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Ali ibn Husayn, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Usamah ibn Zayd. I said: Messenger of Allah, where will you stay tomorrow? This was during his Hajj, when we were near Makkah. He said: Did Aqil leave a dwelling for us?
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Mihran al-Razi, Ibn Abi Umar, and Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte uns, all from Abd al-Razzaq. Ibn Mihran said: Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Ali ibn Husayn, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Usamah ibn Zayd. I said: Messenger of Allah, where will you stay tomorrow? This was during his Hadsch, when we were near Makka. Er sagte: Did Aqil leave a dwelling for us? Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب النُّزُولِ بِمَكَّةَ لِلْحَاجِّ وَتَوْرِيثِ دُورِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ، وَزَمْعَةُ، بْنُ صَالِحٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ، بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيْنَ تَنْزِلُ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَذَلِكَ زَمَنَ الْفَتْحِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَهَلْ تَرَكَ لَنَا عَقِيلٌ مِنْ مَنْزِلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated it to me. Rawh ibn Ubadah narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Abi Hafsah and Zam'ah ibn Salih narrated to us. They said: Ibn Shihab narrated to us, from Ali ibn Husayn, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Usamah ibn Zayd, who said: Messenger of Allah, where will you stay tomorrow, if Allah wills? This was at the time of the conquest. He said: Did Aqil leave a dwelling for us?
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated it to me. Rawh ibn Ubadah überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Abi Hafsah and Zam'ah ibn Salih überlieferte uns. They said: Ibn Shihab überlieferte uns, from Ali ibn Husayn, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Usamah ibn Zayd, who said: Messenger of Allah, where will you stay tomorrow, if Allah wills? This was at the time of the conquest. Er sagte: Did Aqil leave a dwelling for us? Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1352 a, book 15, باب جَوَازِ الإِقَامَةِ بِمَكَّةَ لِلْمُهَاجِرِ مِنْهَا بَعْدَ فَرَاغِ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ بِلاَ زِيَادَةٍ
title: باب جَوَازِ الإِقَامَةِ بِمَكَّةَ لِلْمُهَاجِرِ مِنْهَا بَعْدَ فَرَاغِ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ بِلاَ زِيَادَةٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، يَسْأَلُ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ يَقُولُ هَلْ سَمِعْتَ فِي الإِقَامَةِ، بِمَكَّةَ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ السَّائِبُ سَمِعْتُ الْعَلاَءَ بْنَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لِلْمُهَاجِرِ إِقَامَةُ ثَلاَثٍ بَعْدَ الصَّدَرِ بِمَكَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ كَأَنَّهُ يَقُولُ لاَ يَزِيدُ عَلَيْهَا ‏.‏
translation_en: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab narrated to us. Sulayman, meaning Ibn Bilal, narrated to us, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Humayd, who heard Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz asking al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid: Did you hear anything about staying in Makkah? Al-Sa'ib said: I heard al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: A Muhajir may stay in Makkah for three days after completing the rites. It is as though he meant that he should not stay longer than that.
translation_de: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab überlieferte uns. Sulayman, meaning Ibn Bilal, überlieferte uns, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Humayd, who heard Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz asking al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid: Did you hear anything about staying in Makka? Al-Sa'ib said: I heard al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami say: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: A Muhajir may stay in Makka for drei Tage after completing the rites. It is as though he meant that he should not stay longer than that. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.
